overall_goal: Unload the dishwasher and put away clean dishes and items

goals.description: Unload plates and saucepans from the dishwasher bottom rack
goals.rationale: The person removes plates and saucepans from the bottom rack and stacks them in the cupboard.

goals.description: Unload bowls and cups from the dishwasher bottom rack
goals.rationale: The person takes bowls and cups from the bottom rack and places them on the cupboard shelves.

goals.description: Dry and store plastic containers from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person retrieves plastic containers, shakes off water, dries them with a cloth, and stores them.

goals.description: Unload and organize cutlery from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person unloads various pieces of cutlery from the dishwasher and organizes them in the cutlery tray.

goals.description: Transition to the dishwasher top rack and store the colander
goals.rationale: The person closes the bottom rack, opens the top rack, and puts away a metal colander.

goals.description: Unload and store bowls from the dishwasher top rack
goals.rationale: The person takes multiple bowls from the top rack, stacks them, and places them in the cupboard.

goals.description: Unload and store cups, glasses, and a saucepan
goals.rationale: The person unloads cups, glasses, and a saucepan, placing them in their respective cupboards.

goals.description: Dry and store a white bowl from the dishwasher top rack
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a wet white bowl, dries it thoroughly with a cloth, and stores it.

goals.description: Unload and store ramekins, plates, and lids from the dishwasher top rack
goals.rationale: The person unloads ramekins, plates, and plastic lids from the top rack and organizes them in the cupboard.

goals.description: Put away the V60 coffee filter and stand from the drying rack
goals.rationale: The person takes a coffee filter and stand from the drying rack and puts them away in a cupboard.

goals.description: Unpack a plastic food box and close the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person unpacks a plastic food box on the counter and pushes the dishwasher top rack closed.
